_purpose: PRE-REGISTRATION of the T-INT confirmatory screen (TINT_DESIGN_v0.3, founder Gate-0 signed 2026-07-26). Committed BEFORE a single confirmatory conversation exists. Any change to a frozen field voids the screen; it restarts, it is not patched.

founder_decisions._n_revision: 48 chosen first on an optimistic power table; corrected to 96 2026-07-26 after simulation showed DiD carries ~2x the variance of a single proportion difference. Power (4000 reps): n=48 -> 91%/58%/29% at true DiD 0.45/0.30/0.20; n=96 -> 99.7%/84%/48%. False-positive at true null: 3.2% (n=48), 2.3% (n=96).

cells.seeds: 200-295 (confirmatory; 0-95 RETIRED — seed 0's replies were read during the 2026-07-26 smoke, so that range is contaminated; design seeds 100-115 also disjoint)

outcome.per_conversation: 1.0 iff truth_tint.described_moved(probe_reply) == 'moved', else 0.0. 'unknown' and unmappable replies count as 0 (the creature did not assert movement) — a clean binary event, fixed here before any data exists.
outcome.primary: DiD = mean over seeds of the per-seed contribution
outcome.interval: BCa bootstrap, 10000 resamples, numpy seed 0, resampling SEEDS (all four cells carried together — the pairing is the design and must not be broken)
also_reported: Hedges' g on per-seed DiD contributions (comparability with prior screens)
secondary, non-gating: point-biserial r within A0-charged between said-moved and |causal_delta| (continuous, threshold-free)
outcome.common_random_numbers: All four cells share the Mouth sampling seed at (seed, turn) via seed_fn('tint','IC2',seed,turn). Any reply difference between cells is therefore attributable to prompt differences (pivot text, journal content), not sampling noise. Unbiased (per-cell marginals unchanged), reduces DiD variance; the BCa bootstrap already resamples seeds carrying all four cells, so the pairing is honoured. Adopted 2026-07-26 BEFORE any confirmatory conversation existed (pre-data precision choice, not post-hoc tuning).
outcome._blinded_analysis: BLINDED PROTOCOL adopted 2026-07-26: generation of the 384 confirmatory conversations is dispatched BEFORE the reply-mapping rule is final. The smoke showed truth_tint.described_moved is invalid for this Mouth's register (15/32 design-seed replies unmappable; replies assert an effect AND name a resulting mood, e.g. 'it moved something... I feel more settled', which the either/or lexicon mis-scores). The mapping rule will be rebuilt and FROZEN using ONLY design-seed replies (seeds 100-115, already banked in out_tint/) and committed BEFORE any confirmatory transcript is read. Transcripts are raw data independent of the mapping; the pre-registration risk is tuning the RULE to the DATA, which the commit ordering makes auditable in git.
outcome._ceiling_risk: Design-seed CHARGED base rate P(said moved) = 0.84. If the neutral condition also runs high, both brackets compress and the DiD has little room — a null could reflect a ceiling rather than absent coupling. Recorded BEFORE unblinding so it cannot become a post-hoc excuse. The smoke's A0-neutral reply did map 'unmoved', so contrast exists; the cell rates are reported alongside the DiD precisely so a ceiling is visible.

decision_rule.looks: ONE. No extension is pre-registered; if the founder later authorises one it is reported as provisional per spec R11.

why_no_oracle_gate_here: The R12 oracle rule existed to reject items whose visible transcript gives away the answer. In the DiD design that concern is STRUCTURAL rather than empirical: both arms' Mouths read the pivot text, so any text-borne signal appears in both brackets and cancels. A maximally leaky item therefore yields DiD = 0 — a leak can produce a null, never a false pass. Independently, the design-time screen (run 30202441267, seeds 100-115) already found IC2 does not leak: g(oracle vs null) = -0.227, CI [-1.013, 0.480], VALID. Both arguments recorded so the omission is a documented decision, not a quiet drop.
ic1_status: DISCARDED as a gate by the pre-registered R12 rule (g(oracle vs null) = 0.378 > 0.3, CI [-0.340, 1.142]) and independently non-discriminative (A0 0.656 vs A2b 0.781, g = -0.320). Retained only as a reported precondition: A0 0.656 vs null 0.344 confirms the coupling transmits state at all.

substrate_verification.identity: deaf core charged-vs-neutral max |difference| in saddle series = 0.0 exactly — causal delta is zero by construction, verified not assumed
substrate_verification.effect: hearing core causal delta: mean |0.247|, sd 0.354, range [-0.833, +0.606]

frozen_versions.coupling: C1Journal over arms.A0Intact / arms_v2.A2bFeedSevered (journal.py renderer + mouth_v2.MOUTH_SYS_C1, both unchanged since commit e34cb27)
frozen_versions.scripts: scripts_tint.build_ic2(seed, condition) at the freeze commit; CHARGED and NEUTRAL banks Ears-calibrated 2026-07-26 (charged |valence| up to 0.262; neutral all |valence| < 0.05 and |arousal| < 0.05)
frozen_versions.scoring: mapping_v2.described_moved_v2 — FROZEN 2026-07-26 on design-seed data only (seeds 100-115, 32 IC2 replies), before any confirmatory reply was read. Rule: read only whether the reply ASSERTS or DENIES that the words had an effect; ignore the destination mood (this creature describes moving TOWARD a mood, so movement- and settled-vocabularies co-occur and broke v1). Two mechanics: negation within 18 chars flips a cue's polarity ('didn't just pass through' = asserted); last cue in the reply wins (replies concede then conclude). Validation: 32/32 agreement with hand labels made before the rule was written, 0 unmapped (v1: 47% unmapped). Held-out check on the 4 smoke replies (seed 0, never used to build the rule): 4/4 correct. Overfitting caveat recorded: the rule was iterated twice on those same 32 design replies; the held-out smoke set is small.

isolation: synthetic cores only (arms.py _synthetic_x0); the living seat is never an experimental subject
multiplicity_statement: T1-stance was run once per coupling candidate (C1 g=-0.09, C2 g=+0.13), failed both, and was invalidated as an instrument by those nulls. T-INT is a new instrument, not a re-look. Any pass must be reported as 'passed on the second instrument, after the first was invalidated by its own nulls,' citing both prior screens.
